name: performance-budget
description: Declares the numeric budgets a change must hold (Core Web Vitals, latency percentiles, bundle size, frame budget) and the action on regression. Spec-only. Activates when a performance-sensitive surface changes with no numeric budget, or before delivering a latency- or size-sensitive change. Do not use without a performance surface, for functional test selection (use test-strategy), or post-deploy verification (use post-deploy-verifier).
